plain_language.what_did_we_find: The actual host successfully measured memory for the supervised preflight process and confirmed cleanup. One earlier sandbox-denied preflight is preserved. The five adapter examples still have no observer results.
plain_language.is_it_interesting: Yes as a launch-control check: the machine can observe and stop the selected process profile. It says nothing about variable-operation correctness.
plain_language.does_it_require_more_work: Run only the separately registered five-case smoke on both exact observer profiles, preserving raw outputs and every failed attempt. The scientific matrix needs its own reviewed corpus and launch gate afterward.

findings.committed_gate: check_frozen_inputs, committed smoke manifest and committed RSS preflight independently passed. All runtime/tooling/scientific bindings still match.
findings.resource: Attempt 2 records actual macOS ps backend; positive backend preflight and five process samples, peak observed child RSS 9,945,088 bytes, no timeout/memory/monitor fault, zero exit/stderr and cleanup_complete=true. Raw stream lengths and hashes match.
findings.failure: Attempt 1 records sandbox /bin/ps EPERM before child launch and remains unchanged; retry on actual host resolves capability without erasing failure.
findings.scope: Five fixed hand-written smoke cases, seven stage outputs on each of two profiles, are separately manifest-bound and excluded from scientific vector counts. Their expected output trees were independently hand-calculated earlier.
findings.limits: This authorizes the registered smoke under exact controls only. Scientific launch awaits committed corpus lock, smoke-result audit and separate prelaunch review.
